subject: [PATCH v2 4/4] kernfs: fix up the unlocked attribute reads on the creation paths

2026-09-05.patch_summary: This patch fixes two issues in the kernfs subsystem related to attribute reads during creation paths. In kernfs_create_link(), the code copies the target's owner attributes without holding a lock, which can lead to inconsistent ownership if the target is modified between the two reads. To fix this, the patch adds a lock to ensure both reads are done under the same lock. In kernfs_new_node(), the code reads the parent's mode and group ID for S_ISGID inheritance without holding a lock, but since the node does not exist yet, taking the lock would only introduce unnecessary contention. Instead, the patch marks these reads with READ_ONCE() to ensure consistency. The changes address issues introduced by a previous commit that allowed creating kernfs objects with arbitrary uid/gid.
